votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 30 of 2024 with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing the need to support the health of the Great Salt Lake.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall directing public entities within Salt Lake City to consider water conservation efforts and legislation to help preserve the Great Salt Lake for future generations.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Ordinance: Text Amendment to Prohibit Demolition of Dwelling Units for Parking Uses to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing for a proposed ordinance that would prohibit demolition of dwelling units for stand-alone parking uses and restrict expansion or modification of parking for existing uses unless additional housing units are included, due to an advertising error.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Ordinance: City-wide Text Amendment for Gas Station Standards to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing for a proposed ordinance establishing more stringent zoning standards for gas stations near water bodies, parks, and open spaces and in secondary groundwater recharge areas, due to an advertising error.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 67 of 2024 amending the Fiscal Year 2025 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for specified items, and request the Administration develop proposed language addressing allocation of costs for administering future elections conducted in accordance with Article VII.
votes.description: A partial adoption of Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2024-25 covering numerous items including airport interim financing, parks capital projects, public lands maintenance, homeless shelter grants, and other adjustments, while keeping the budget amendment open for a subsequent public hearing and additional items.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 29 of 2024 (Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan).
votes.description: Adopts the City's Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan to guide response, recovery, preparedness, and mitigation operations during disasters, including coordination with Salt Lake County and the State of Utah.

votes.motion: Defer action on the Resolution: Updating Salt Lake City's Collective Bargaining and Employee Representation Processes to a future date.
votes.description: Postpones consideration of a resolution that would update the City's collective bargaining and employee representation processes, including creating a procedure to determine whether employee groups should be represented by a different labor union, to allow additional time for dialogue with unions.

Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates for zoning and text amendment ordinances, a budget amendment public hearing date, a HUD community development needs hearing date, Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 1) for FY2024-25, and board appointments for Jane Kim (Sister Cities Advisory Board) and Babs DeLay (Historic Landmark Commission reappointment).
